name: saas-metrics
description: Use this skill when calculating, analyzing, or reporting SaaS business metrics. Triggers on MRR, ARR, churn rate, LTV, CAC, LTV:CAC ratio, cohort analysis, net revenue retention, expansion revenue, board deck metrics, investor reporting, unit economics, payback period, or SaaS financial modeling. Covers metric definitions, formulas, spreadsheet implementation, cohort tables, and board-ready reporting for founders, finance teams, and growth operators.

findings.excerpt: Run `npx skills add AbsolutelySkilled/AbsolutelySkilled --skill saas-metrics` in your terminal. The skill will be immediately available in your AI coding agent.
